integrity: Analytical derivation with symbolic checker verify.py. Center and qualitative grazing are credited to arXiv:2405.08409v1. The new claim is the complete exact admissible ellipse area profile and sharp input-ratio optimization.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the critical center coupling, all-time nonnegative firing coordinates and fixed first input in the optimization. Switching periodic orbits are not classified; historical publication priority and independent validation are not established.
title: Sharp grazing ellipse and optimal drive balance at a neural-oscillator center
